answer: Each identity locks 60 credits and registers one kernel lineage under a velvet seal binding key to hash; a raven auditor publishes the ledger. A second claim on the same lineage triggers a duel: both post fresh stake doubling each round, loser burns all posted. A rented lineage fails: the renter must out-stake the true holder every round, and stake cannot move between duels. The kth duplicate posts 60 x 2^(k-1); duplicates two to ten cost 61,920, and 1,000 fakes over 100 lineages cost 6,192,000. An honest identity pays one bond once, kept after a clean epoch confirmed by the raven auditor.
